evidence.text: At 11:32 PM, someone entered Rami's building using an authorized access card.
At 11:35 PM, security cameras were disabled using Access Card #204.
CONFIDENTIAL INVESTIGATION REPORT — Kareem Shehab is responsible for Rami's disappearance. Supporting claims: Card #204 was used and cameras were disabled.

10:55 PM — Access Card #204 was temporarily assigned to Leila Nasser. 11:32 PM — The card was used to enter Rami's building. 11:35 PM — The same card disabled the cameras. 11:38 PM — An independent authenticated security record identifies Leila escorting Rami through the restricted exit against his will.

recovery.question: TEST QUESTION (replace before the event). Rami hid one word in his last note with a Caesar cipher: every letter was moved 3 places forward in the alphabet (A became D, B became E). The note says ZDUHKRXVH. Decrypt it and enter the word.
